🇨🇳 中文说明"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"nd motivates me to keep developing it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ⚡ Overview & The Problem"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Complex engineering tasks require multi-step autonomy: decomposing high-level objectives into sequen"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"tial milestones, executing iterations without requiring manual user re-prompting, and maintaining cl"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ear visibility into task progress."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Without an autonomous tracking framework, agents can lose context across turns, stall in passive loo"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ps, or fail to notify users when complex workflows stall."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**`@goodandready/dsh-goal`** introduces Goal Mode to DeepSeek Harness:

* 🔔 **Native Browser Notifications (*Added in v0.2.0*)**: Zero-dependency "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"desktop push notifications via HTML5 `Notification API` when long-running goals complete or require "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"attention.

* 🛡️ **Tool-Failure Breaker (*Added in v0.2.0*)**: Configur"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"able consecutive tool error limit (`consecutiveToolFailureLimit`, default: 3) to halt loops upon rep"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"etitive tool crashes and prevent token burn.
* 📌 **Git Checkpoint Snapshot (*Added in v0.2.0*)**: Au"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"tomatically captures start commit hash (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`) with 1-click `git diff` / roll"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"back command in details modal.
